# Post caption length

**How long is the written caption under the post?** · [all approaches](index.md) · clashes: C9


## Short: two lines or less
<a id="short"></a>

Every word earns its place. No paragraph over two lines.

**Looks like:** One hook line, one value line, a CTA, and 3–5 tags. It reads in two seconds above 'more'.

**Good at:** readability; punch; speed to write

**Weak at:** less room for SEO and story; less personal

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short, story · niches all · goals speed, reach · effort low

**How:** Write it, then cut every word that can go (pull-out test).

**Backed by:** [No paragraph over two lines](../topics/text.md#text-two-line-paragraphs), [Every word not working works against you](../topics/text.md#text-kaplans-law), [Caption: hook line, story, CTA, 3–5 tags](../topics/text.md#text-caption-structure), [Hook window: 2–3 s short, 15–20 s long](../topics/hooks.md#hook-window-short-vs-long), [Word-by-word captions, key word highlighted](../topics/text.md#text-word-by-word-highlight) · sources L09

## Long candid note
<a id="long-candid"></a>

A personal note that rewards readers ('I don't know if any of you read the caption...').

**Looks like:** The first line hooks, then several paragraphs about what happened behind the reel, ending with a question. Readers comment about the caption itself.

**Good at:** trust; comments; loyal followers

**Weak at:** most viewers never open it; takes time to write well

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, carousel · niches all · goals trust, comments · effort medium

**How:** Write it like a letter: time, place, what happened. Keep the paragraphs short.

**Backed by:** [Long candid caption as a personal note](../topics/text.md#text-long-candid-caption), [Intro = time, place, what's happening](../topics/story.md#story-time-place-intro), [Caption: hook line, story, CTA, 3–5 tags](../topics/text.md#text-caption-structure), [Short form = awareness, long = conversion](../topics/growth.md#growth-short-awareness-long-conversion), [Waterfall and repurpose winners](../topics/growth.md#growth-waterfall) · sources R1, L09

## Structured: hook, value, CTA, keywords
<a id="structured-seo"></a>

A template: a keyword hook line, 1–3 lines of story or value, a send/save CTA, and 3–5 precise tags.

**Looks like:** 'Khandala sunset point nobody stops at' as line 1 (searchable), two lines of context, 'Send this to the colleague who...', a location tag and 4 hashtags.

**Good at:** search; consistency; shares via the CTA

**Weak at:** can read as formulaic; less personal

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, carousel · niches all · goals reach, shares, saves · effort low

**How:** Use the copy-pack template, and put the place or keyword in the first 125 characters.

**Backed by:** [Caption: hook line, story, CTA, 3–5 tags](../topics/text.md#text-caption-structure), [Keywords in caption and text over hashtags](../topics/text.md#text-seo-over-hashtags), [Modular brief](../topics/business.md#biz-modular-brief), [Lead-magnet CTA over a recap strip](../topics/growth.md#l11-lead-magnet-recap-cta) · sources SP, KH

## Long, but in short paragraphs
<a id="long-in-short-paragraphs"></a>

Rahul's length with Harry's rhythm: a long caption made of one- and two-line paragraphs.

**Looks like:** Eight short paragraphs, each one or two lines, like monkey bars. It's long but easy to swing through on a phone.

**Good at:** trust and readability together; SEO room; easy on a phone

**Weak at:** still a lot of writing per post; most viewers still won't open it

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, carousel · niches all · goals trust, comments · effort medium

**How:** Draft it in the Instagram caption box to see the real line breaks.

**Backed by:** [No paragraph over two lines](../topics/text.md#text-two-line-paragraphs), [Long candid caption as a personal note](../topics/text.md#text-long-candid-caption), [Draft in the final tool, judge in context](../topics/process.md#proc-write-in-final-tool), [Caption: hook line, story, CTA, 3–5 tags](../topics/text.md#text-caption-structure), [Hook window: 2–3 s short, 15–20 s long](../topics/hooks.md#hook-window-short-vs-long) · sources L09, R1

## Mixing
All can share the same first line; only what comes after 'more' changes.

## Rule of thumb
Fast or vibe posts: short. Story or personal posts: long candid. Search-driven travel or tips: structured. Trust-heavy posts: long in short paragraphs.
